Synthetic 100 ms, 44.1 kHz stereo test tones generated for this project (different sine frequencies in each channel). No commercial audio. AIFF was converted from a Python-generated PCM WAV using macOS afconvert. FLAC uses lossless verbatim subframes, with CRC8, CRC16 and a STREAMINFO MD5, generated with generate_flac.py. Tests verify sample rate, duration and independent channels.
